title: Design, nanogel synthesis, anti-proliferative activity and in silico ADMET profile of pyrazoles and pyrimidines as topo-II inhibitors and DNA intercalators

Pyrazole derivatives 2 and 3, pyrimidine derivative 4, and their nanogels as drug delivery systems were synthesized, and their cytotoxicity against MCF-7, HCT-116, HepG2 and A549 cells was evaluated.
